findings.issue: recordPatientConsentInDb executed insert into patientConsents and update of administrativeProfile outside of transaction, risking inconsistent state on failure.
findings.resolution: Wrapped in db.transaction(async (tx) => { ... }) for strict ACID compliance.

findings.issue: Failed to propagate ambient clinicId context (app.current_clinic) and app.current_organization_id, limiting multi-clinic isolation and new RLS policies.
findings.resolution: Added currentClinicStorage, clinicId option in ResilientTransactionOptions, and GUC configuration inside transaction.

findings.issue: Watchdog only checked SELECT 1 and destroyed streams; pooled backends stuck in 'idle in transaction' would starve connection pool in Tier 4 Master SaaS.
findings.resolution: Implemented terminateHungIdleTransactions scanning pg_stat_activity and executing pg_terminate_backend on hung connections older than threshold.

findings.issue: ensureOrganizationCashBoxes did not support branchId, preventing Tier 3 branch networks from provisioning separate cash registers for different clinics.
findings.resolution: Added branchId and branchNamePrefix parameters and automatic clinic iteration in seedCashAndReasons.

findings.issue: Seeder did not invoke clinical core, cash boxes, or document template seeds, leaving fresh environments in a broken state.
findings.resolution: Added automated invocation of seedClinicalCore, seedCashAndReasons, and seedAll49DocumentTemplates upon completion of state migration.

findings.issue: Migrations 0206, 0207, 0208 were pending, causing missing column errors on imaging_studies which aborted transactions with code 25P02 during visit completion.
findings.resolution: Executed tsx apps/api/src/scripts/migrate.ts, successfully applying all 187 migrations.
